main_text.p: illorū similes qui Prophetis dicebant: Ne vi-Efa. 30.deatis,ne cōtemplemini, Nec nos socios ad-iungamus ciuibus Anathoth interdicentibus Ier. 11.Ieremiæ nc in nomine Domini prophetaret. Sētiamus potí spirituales morbos animi & à Reg.fuf.Basilio discamus obiurgationē esse animę cudisp.int.ratione. Agnoscamus tot errores quibus in 53.hoc vitæ curriculo sumus obnoxij, & postule mus, nedum recusemus. Pastorum nostro-rum oculis dirigi atque gubernari vt verbo Dei duce ac præuio rectam salutis viam con stanter persequamur, donec tandem ad fœ-licitatis metam nobis propositam peruenire valeamus. Sed iam redeundum est ad Da-uidem.

Psalmum concludit excellentissima cohor Pars tertatione ad pœnitentiam (quæ est huius Psal-tia Psal.mi postrema pars.) Quia vero nihil tam con Ab ob-trarium est veræ pœnitentiæ quàm obdure-stinatio-scere in peccatis, idcirco nos reuocat ab o-ne cauē-mni peruicacia & obstinatione. Atque vt dum.id præstet facilius, petit à brutis animanti-bus similitudinem, à quibus quàm maxi-me nobis abhorrendum esse vel ab ipsa na-tura didicimus. Ergo, inquit, si vobis viam ad pœnitentiam munitam esse vultis, in pri-mis cauete ne nimia peccandi consuetu-do iam callum animis vestris obducat, a-lioquin brutorum potius estis quàm homi-num similes futuri. Annon videtis equos

page.notes: Reading of the marginal references is approximate; the small italic marginal words ("ne cauē-", "dum.", "Ab ob-") are partly cut by the binding and some letters are uncertain. "Ier.11." and "Reg.fuf." are abbreviations as printed. Several words in the text are printed with a lost or faint final letter at the line end, but the words above were read in full. The catchword-like "i.ij." at the foot is a signature, not a catchword. Some letters in the marginal lines near "Psalmum" are uncertain.
